description: This file defines the PlacementStrategyResolver class responsible for determining and resolving placement strategies for grains in Orleans, including handling default and specific strategies, utilizing dependency injection, and multiple resolvers.

classes.name: PlacementStrategyResolver
classes.description: Class responsible for resolving placement strategies based on grain type, including default and custom strategies with support for multiple resolvers and grain properties.

methods.name: PlacementStrategyResolver
methods.description: Constructor initializing the resolver with services, resolvers, and grain properties resolver.

methods.name: GetPlacementStrategy
methods.description: Gets the placement strategy associated with the specified grain type, with caching.

methods.name: TryGetNonDefaultPlacementStrategy
methods.description: Attempts to get a non-default placement strategy based on grain properties and resolvers.

methods.name: GetPlacementStrategyInternal
methods.description: Internal method to determine the placement strategy for a given grain type, falling back to default.
